inputs.prompt: An older man sits at his desk at home in the evening, on a video call, seen by his laptop's webcam. He listens to a colleague giving an update: he looks at his screen just below the lens with a warm, attentive face and blinks naturally. He rubs his chin once with a thoughtful look, then lowers his hand out of the picture and gives a small nod. His lips stay closed: he does not speak at any time. Small natural movements only, like a real person listening on a video call. His hands stay out of the picture. Nobody enters the picture and nobody walks past behind him. The camera is a fixed laptop webcam: the framing does not change at all. At the end he is back in the same pose as at the start, looking at his screen. One continuous shot with no cuts, no zoom, no pan, no music, no subtitles and no text.

expect.basis: WP3 paid about $0.17 for a 5 s take at 768P on this route (the hand-off); the dry run shows the live price
